next_step_recommendation: Choose a paradigm_shift next. Move to an explicit chain-rule joint-law model over daily 25-cell logit transitions with full per-day covariance, because the next model should represent cross-cell dependence in the likelihood itself rather than hoping a high-dimensional FM velocity discovers it from arbitrary source noise.
